disclosure: The screenshots show a fictional company on a generated demo workspace. The agent, approval and Rewind screens use a scripted demo provider, not a model; the window frame is drawn afterwards.

shots.title: Changes view across four repositories
shots.alt: IntelyIDE Changes view: four repositories in one tree, each file tagged with its repository and branch, with one commit message box for the checked files.
shots.caption: One tree for four repositories, one commit message for the checked files.
shots.scene: Four repos in the Changes tree with badges, branch pills and tri-state ticks; fb-api/src/orders/totals.ts selected; unified multi-hunk diff beside the list; the Commit button shows its repo and file counts.

shots.title: Shared commit message
shots.alt: Commit box with a conventional-commit message typed and a button that shows how many files and repositories it will commit.
shots.caption: A shared message and the counts on the button.
shots.scene: Shared message typed (conventional-commit text); the button label shows the counts.

shots.title: Hunk staging
shots.alt: Diff tab of a file with three hunks, one of them staged, showing the partially staged state.
shots.caption: Stage single hunks.
shots.scene: Diff tab of the fb-api file that has exactly three hunks, with one hunk staged (partially staged state).

shots.title: Push dialog with live-branch confirmation
shots.alt: Push dialog for a live branch: the exact branch name must be typed before the Push button is enabled.
shots.caption: Pushing to a live branch needs the branch name typed in full.
shots.scene: Push dialog for the four repos; fb-mobile on main shows the typed live-branch confirmation field; one repo is ahead by three commits and one has a commit to pull.

shots.title: Split diff beside the branch graph
shots.alt: Split diff of a changed file next to the branch graph of the repository.
shots.caption: Split diff and branch graph with merge lanes and tags.
shots.scene: Split diff of a changed file beside the branch graph with merge lanes and tags; one commit detail open.

shots.title: Agent run waiting for approval
shots.alt: Agent chat with an approval drawer; the transcript shows that a git commit attempt by the agent was refused.
shots.caption: The agent asks before it runs a command, and a commit attempt is refused.
shots.scene: Agent mode with run A paused on the permission card for pnpm db:migrate; a scripted transcript line shows a git commit attempt refused with the hard-stop message text; usage chip; session list with three runs; the enforcement chip as it really shows. Scripted mock provider, no model call.

shots.title: Rewind a finished agent run
shots.alt: Rewind view listing the snapshot taken before an agent run, with a Restore action per repository.
shots.caption: Every agent run starts from a snapshot you can restore.
shots.scene: After run B is Done: the Rewind view of its pre-run snapshot with the changed files and the restore control.
requires: Rewind UI entry reachable from a finished run
